findings.evidence: Manifold.lean:41 `abbrev realSpinLieModel (n : ℕ) := ... (MonoidHom.range (spinGroup.toUnits (Q := realCliffordForm n 0)))`. The PR docstring: 'Unlike native `Spin(0)`, which is trivial'. LowRank/Zero.lean names: `card_evenUnitaryGroup_of_subsingleton`, `finite_evenUnitaryGroup_of_subsingleton`.
findings.fix: Name it after the carrier, following the adjacent `LowRank/Zero.lean` terminology, e.g. `evenUnitaryGroupZeroLieModel` (or `realEvenUnitaryZeroLieModel`).
findings.issue: `realSpinZeroLieModel` reads as the n = 0 case of the existing `realSpinLieModel n` (Manifold.lean:41). That model is built from `spinGroup.toUnits`, while this one is built from `evenUnitaryGroup`. The two names suggest the same object and denote different groups (trivial vs μ₂).

findings.evidence: Manifold.lean:47 `instance instChartedSpaceRealSpin (n : ℕ) : ChartedSpace (realSpinLieModel n) (spinGroup (realCliffordForm n 0))`. Manifold.lean:83 `instance instLieGroupRealSpin (n : ℕ) : LieGroup ... (spinGroup (realCliffordForm n 0))`. The PR's `local notation "μ₂" => evenUnitaryGroup Q₀`.
findings.fix: Rename all of them consistently with the carrier, e.g. `isClosed_evenUnitaryGroupZero`, `evenUnitaryGroupZero_lieSubalgebra_eq_bot`, `evenUnitaryGroupZeroEmbeddedLieSubgroupData`, `instLieGroupEvenUnitaryGroupZero`, `isSmoothEmbedding_evenUnitaryGroupZero_subtypeVal`.
findings.issue: The same misleading `RealSpin`/`realSpin` prefix appears on every other new declaration: `instFiniteRealSpinZero` (48), `isClosed_realSpinZero` (61), `realSpinZero_lieSubalgebra_eq_bot` (67), `instSubsingletonRealSpinZeroLieModel` (73), `realSpinZeroEmbeddedLieSubgroupData` (81), `instChartedSpaceRealSpinZero` (87), `instLieGroupRealSpinZero` (91), `instSubsingletonRealSpinZeroLieAlgebra` (95) and `isSmoothEmbedding_realSpinZero_subtypeVal` (103). `instChartedSpaceRealSpinZero` and `instLieGroupRealSpinZero` read as the n = 0 specialisations of `instChartedSpaceRealSpin` and `instLieGroupRealSpin`, which belong to native `spinGroup`.

summary: The new `realSpinZero*` names reuse the `realSpin*` prefix that Tau Ceti already uses for native `spinGroup (realCliffordForm n 0)`, but they name `evenUnitaryGroup (realCliffordForm 0 0)`, which the PR itself says is a different group from native Spin(0). `realSpinZeroLieModel` sits next to `realSpinLieModel 0` and denotes something else, which misleads users.
